name: ast-graph
description: Local per-repo code graph so coding agents get exact line spans, callers, blast radius, and covering tests instead of reading whole files. TypeScript/JS, Python, Go, Rust, plus structural support for Java, C#, Ruby, PHP, SQL, Terraform, and more.
suggestedPrompts: Assess this repository and synchronize its AST GraphDB index
Compute the 3-hop upstream blast radius and covering tests for a core symbol
Trace end-to-end cross-layer lineage across schemas, HTTP routes, and infrastructure
